title: HE WAS ASLEEP.
paragraphs:
Not pretending.
Not meditating.
Not “resting His eyes.”

While the Sea of Galilee was turning violent.
While the boat groaned like it might split in half.
While seasoned fishermen—men who had survived storms their entire lives—started to panic.

Water crashing.
Wind screaming.
Wood cracking.

“Teacher! Don’t You care that we are perishing?”
— Mark 4:38
Hear the accusation hiding in that cry.

But:
“Why are You calm while we are terrified?”
We say the same thing today.

When the diagnosis arrives.
When the bills stack like waves.
When the marriage feels like it's breaking apart plank by plank.

No panic.
No hurry.
No fear in His eyes.
He simply stands in the storm.
Then He speaks three words that shake the universe.

The wind obeys.
The waves kneel.
The sea turns glass-smooth.
Then Jesus turns to the disciples.

“Why are you so afraid? Have you still no faith?”
— Mark 4:40
If I am in the boat… why are you terrified of the storm?
Here is the deeper truth most people miss.
The greatest miracle that night was not the calm sea.
It was Who was in the boat.

The One who slept through chaos…
was the same One who would later sleep in a tomb.

Sin defeated.
Death crushed.
Grace unleashed.
The same Christ who commands wind and waves now offers peace to every storm inside the human heart.

Your fear.
Your guilt.
Your hidden shame.
He speaks the same command over you today:
Friend, if your life feels like a sinking boat right now, hear this clearly:

Because from scandal to grace—
Jesus still rewrites everything.
“We tell the stories that shame tried to erase.”
